headline: Toddlers still wake at night. It doesn't mean you went backwards.
items: The 'Mama?' down the hall, checking you still exist
A cup of water requested urgently at 2am, then not drunk at all
A small hand patting your face in the dark, making sure it's you
The negotiation over which stuffed animal, held entirely in whispers
turn: It isn't a habit you made. It's someone checking you're there.
